# Owed

> Owed is a PayBox plugin that lets your agent ask anyone for money, then tells you who has paid. Your agent asks one person, splits a bill or sends an invoice, in USDC, SOL or the user's own currency, and anyone can pay it from a Solana wallet, a Base wallet or their own PayBox agent. Before your agent pays, Owed checks the payee: a domain's DNS record or an .sns name on Solana. Everything runs on mainnet with real funds (Solana: USDC or SOL; Base: USDC). Owed never holds money and charges no fees: every payment goes from the payer's wallet straight to the recipient in one transaction.

Owed is submitted to PayBox Chapter 1 and waiting for its listing in the PayBox plugin catalog. Once it is listed: connect PayBox to your agent as an MCP connector (https://api.paybox.sh/mcp) and turn on the Owed plugin in PayBox. Payments your agent proposes are approved by the user with a passkey in PayBox; Owed returns unsigned proposals and never signs anything.

## Tools

The plugin has eleven tools. `recipient` and `sender` are the user's own PayBox Solana wallet address (from PayBox's `list_credentials`), or for a Base request their Base (0x) address.

- `ask_for_money`: create a payment request and get a short link, a QR code and a ready-to-send message that anyone can pay from a Solana wallet or their own PayBox agent. Inputs: `recipient` (a Solana address, an SNS name like `example.sns`, or a Base 0x address with `chain: "base"`), `amount` (decimal string), `token` (`USDC` or `SOL`), optional `currency` (ISO 4217, one of 38, never USD: `amount` is then in that currency and Owed locks the USDC at a live rate, rounded up; Solana USDC only), `chain` (`solana`, the default, or `base` for USDC on Base), `expires_in_days`, `payer_name`, `for`, `note`, `requester_name`, `from_domain`. SNS names are resolved on Solana; `.sol` names are refused (SNS moved to `.sns`), as are tokenized names and lookalike characters. Examples: "ask Priya for 15 USDC for dinner", "ask Priya for ₹1,200 for dinner", "my wallet is bonfida.sns", "bill Alex 20 USDC on Base".
- `check_payments`: check whether up to 20 requests have been paid, by reading Solana mainnet (and Base, for Base requests). Input: `requests` (Owed ids, Owed links or Solana Pay transfer URLs with a reference). Returns each one's status (`open`, `paid`, `underpaid`, `cancelled`, `expired`, `not_found`, `invalid`, `unknown`) with payer, amount and transaction when paid; a payment the recipient matched with `match_payments` is marked matched. Example: "did Priya pay?"
- `pay_link`: pay someone's request (an Owed link or id, any Solana Pay transfer link or QR text, or an SNS name with `amount`; USDC or SOL). Checks the request is still open and the wallet can cover it, then returns an unsigned Solana transaction for the user to approve in PayBox. Inputs: `link`, `sender`, optional `max_amount`, `amount` (only for links without one), `allow_unverified`, `rail` (`solana_pay`, the default, or `x402`: pay an Owed USDC request at its x402 endpoint; PayBox pays it over x402 and the facilitator covers the network fee). Refuses checkout links (Solana Pay transaction requests), paid requests and amounts above `max_amount`. On the x402 rail it checks the request id and the live x402 challenge against the request before proposing the payment. A request made for an SNS name is paid only if the name still points to its wallet. A Base request is paid over x402 from the user's PayBox Base wallet (the facilitator pays the gas), never with a Solana transaction; when that can't be offered, the tool says how to pay it from a Base wallet. Example: "pay bonfida.sns 2 USDC".
- `verify_payee`: check who a request is from: whether a domain publishes the wallet that gets paid, read from DNS by the plugin itself, or which wallet an SNS name points to on Solana. Inputs: `link`, or `address` and `domain`, or `name` (alone, with an address, or with a link). Verified means the domain or name points to the wallet; it shows who controls it, not that the request is fair. Lookalike spellings and internationalized names come with warnings.
- `split_bill`: split a bill into one request per person plus a live board that shows who has paid. Inputs: `recipient`, `total`, `token`, `title`, `people` (2 to 20, each a `name` and an optional set `amount`; the rest split evenly), optional `currency` (the bill is split in that currency and each share locked to USDC at one rate), `requester_name`, `from_domain`. Examples: "split 45 USDC for pizza between Priya, Sam and Alex", "split €45 for dinner".
- `create_invoice`: create a printable invoice with line items, total, due date and invoice number, payable from any Solana wallet by QR or link, or by the client's PayBox agent. Inputs: `recipient`, `token`, `business_name`, `client_name`, `items` (1 to 20, each `description`, `quantity`, `unit_price`), `due_date` (YYYY-MM-DD), optional `currency` (unit prices in that currency; the total is locked to USDC), `invoice_number`, `notes`, `from_domain`. Example: "invoice Acme for 3 hours of consulting at 40 USDC, due Friday".
- `who_owes_me`: show who still owes the user money: every open Owed request, split-bill share and invoice that pays their wallet, plus what was paid in the last 30 days, with totals. Two calls: the first, with `recipient`, returns `message_to_sign`; the user signs it with PayBox `request_wallet_sign` (a passkey approval that moves no money); the second call passes `recipient`, `signed_message` and `signature`. The message is valid for 5 minutes and works once. Anyone can create a request that pays a wallet, so check names and amounts before chasing anyone. Example: "who owes me?"
- `write_reminder`: draft a reminder for someone who hasn't paid: `tone` (`friendly`, `firm` or `formal`) and `channel` (`sms`, `whatsapp` or `email`, which adds a subject), with the pay link and how many days it has been outstanding. Input `request`: an Owed id or link, one split-bill share's link, a split bill's board link (one message for the group naming who still owes) or an invoice link (names the invoice number and due date). It checks Solana first and returns no text if the request is already paid. Owed sends nothing itself. Example: "remind Priya about dinner".
- `ask_every_month`: ask someone for the same amount every month: stores a monthly schedule and opens a new Owed request on that day each month (UTC). Inputs: `recipient`, `amount`, `token`, `payer_name`, `for`, `day_of_month` (1 to 28), optional `months`, `requester_name`, `from_domain`. If today is that day, this month's request opens right away. Each month's request is an ordinary Owed request that `check_payments`, `write_reminder` and `pay_link` work on; `who_owes_me` lists every schedule. Monthly requests are in USDC or SOL only (a rate locked today would be wrong next month). Example: "ask Sam for 450 USDC rent on the 1st".
- `cancel_request`: cancel one of the user's own requests, split-bill shares or invoices so nobody pays it: its page shows Cancelled and `pay_link` refuses it. Two calls like `who_owes_me`: the first, with `link` and `recipient`, returns `message_to_sign`; the second passes `signed_message` and `signature`. Only the wallet the request pays can cancel it; a paid or partly paid request can't be cancelled. Example: "Priya paid me in cash, cancel her link".
- `match_payments`: find payments the user received that Owed never counted (exchanges and some wallets drop the Solana Pay reference, so the money arrives but the request stays open or underpaid). `action` `find` (default): `recipient` plus `requests` (Owed links or ids), or no `requests` to search every open request after a signed ledger message (two calls like `who_owes_me`). Returns candidates: incoming transfers of exactly the amount still due, made after the request and not counted anywhere, each with a confidence, reasons and warnings (two requests with the same amount means Owed can't tell which one a transfer pays, and says so). It marks nothing. `action` `confirm`: `link` and `transaction`; the first call returns `message_to_sign`, the second passes `signed_message` and `signature`; the server re-checks the chain and the request shows "matched by the recipient (no reference on the payment)". `action` `ask_for_rest`: `link` of an underpaid request; creates one request for exactly what is still owed. Example: "Sam says he paid from Coinbase but it still shows open".

## Verified payee

A requester proves a domain by publishing their wallet in DNS: a TXT record named `_owed.<domain>` with the value `owed-pay=<Solana address>` (one record per wallet). `ask_for_money`, `split_bill` and `create_invoice` take an optional `from_domain`; Owed checks the record before creating the request and the pay page shows "From <domain> · verified". Before `pay_link` pays a request that names a domain, the plugin reads the record itself (DNS over HTTPS, cloudflare-dns.com then dns.google) and refuses a wallet the domain doesn't list. Example: `_owed.getowed.xyz` TXT `owed-pay=FN6G4CQkrM55pnT4npu1U8xegZk7AMnp3ApGvkM4cbvs`.

## SNS names

An SNS name (`example.sns`, Solana Name Service) can stand in for a Solana wallet: as `recipient` in `ask_for_money`, as `link` in `pay_link` and as `name` in `verify_payee`. Owed resolves it on Solana itself (the name's SOL record, else its owner). The server re-resolves it when a request is made, the pay page on every render ("To example.sns · verified on-chain"), and `pay_link` before every payment. `.sol` names are refused: in August 2026 SNS moved its names to `.sns`, and `.sol` isn't resolvable today.

## Payments without the reference

A payment counts only when it carries the request's Solana Pay reference. The pay page's QR is a Solana Pay transaction request (`solana:https://www.getowed.xyz/api/v1/pay/<id>`), so a wallet that scans it signs a transaction Owed built with the reference inside. Exchanges and plain sends don't carry it: `match_payments` finds those and counts one only after the recipient signs that it is theirs.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.getowed.xyz/): what Owed does and how to add it in PayBox.
- [Proof](https://www.getowed.xyz/proof): real mainnet payments made from the Owed team's own wallets on every rail (Solana Pay QR, x402, Base), each with its transaction, and what Owed refuses.
- `https://www.getowed.xyz/r/<id>`: a request's pay page: QR code, wallet button, live status, receipt once paid.
- `https://www.getowed.xyz/g/<id>`: a split bill's board, "N of M paid".
- `https://www.getowed.xyz/i/<id>`: a printable invoice.
- `https://www.getowed.xyz/x/<id>`: the request as an x402 endpoint: any x402 agent can pay it (HTTP 402 with the payment terms).
- `https://www.getowed.xyz/api/v1/pay/<id>`: the request as a Solana Pay transaction request (what the QR encodes): a wallet fetches the transaction and signs it.

## Read-only API

JSON, no auth. Errors are `{"error":{"code","message"}}`.

- `GET https://www.getowed.xyz/api/v1/requests/<id>`: a request's terms, status and payment.
- `POST https://www.getowed.xyz/api/v1/status` with `{"ids":[...]}` (up to 20): current status, checked against the chain.
- `GET https://www.getowed.xyz/api/v1/stats`: count and USDC volume of paid requests.
